name: manual_eb6269
claim: When testing cross-repository byte parity between shared probe copies, use an immutable separate probe source checkout rather than bumping the runtime dependency pin; this prevents circular dependency deadlocks and preserves frozen production pins.

decisions.notes: Both Phylax PR #17 and Oramasys PR #71 compare c2_slice2_probe.py against separate 40-hex pinned probe checkouts, maintaining probe parity without mutating older runtime permit pins.

rationale: Both Phylax PR #17 and Oramasys PR #71 compare c2_slice2_probe.py against separate 40-hex pinned probe checkouts, maintaining probe parity without mutating older runtime permit pins.
